Package it.polimi.ingsw.model.item.card

Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.item.card.Card
Direct Known Subclasses:
DrawableCard, StartingCard
public abstract class Card extends Object
Abstract class representing cards in the game. This class is intended to be extended by specific card types.

    • getShowingCorners

      public Symbol[] getShowingCorners()
      Getter method for the showingCorners attribute. Returns a copy of the frontCorners attribute if the showing face is the front one, or an array of Symbol.EMPTY otherwise, because only the starting cards can have symbols on the back.
      Returns:
      a copy of the attribute if the showing face is the front one, or an array of Symbol.EMPTY otherwise.

    • getCenter

      public Symbol[] getCenter()
      Getter method for the Center attribute. Returns an empty array (length = 0) if the showing face is the front one because there's no card with a symbol in the front face's center. Returns a copy of the Center attribute otherwise because that tuple of symbols represents useful resources for card requirements.
      Returns:
      An empty array (length = 0) if the showing face is the front one. A copy of the Center attribute otherwise.
